summary: This bill establishes a grant program for states to increase public school teacher salaries to a minimum of $60,000, adjusted for inflation, and provides additional grants for cost-of-living adjustments in states that already meet this minimum.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on education, specifically on increasing teacher salaries in public schools through federal grants to states. It aims to establish a minimum salary threshold and provide cost-of-living adjustments, directly leading to more spending on public schools.
